message.reasoning:
We need to produce test cases for uncovered exception scenarios for method minus(Indicator<Num>). Need to analyze method behavior. The method:

public NumericIndicator minus(Indicator<Num> other) {
    return NumericIndicator.of(BinaryOperation.difference(this, other));
}

So it calls BinaryOperation.difference(this, other). We need to consider possible exceptions: null other, other with mismatched BarSeries (different series length), other returning null values, other being same instance? Usually difference will check for null and series compatibility. We need to infer from library. Likely BinaryOperation.difference checks that other is not null, and that both indicators have same BarSeries (or at least same series). If other is null -> NullPointerException. If other.getBarSeries() != this.getBarSeries() -> IllegalArgumentException. If other returns null for a value at index -> NullPointerException maybe. Also if this is null? Not possible because method called on instance.

Thus we need test groups for minus_nullOther, minus_differentSeries, minus_indicatorWithNullValue (maybe). Also maybe minus_when index out of bounds? The resulting indicator will be used later; but minus itself just creates new indicator; no immediate exception unless other is null.

Thus create test cases:

Group: minus_nullOther: input other = null, expected NullPointerException.

Group: minus_differentSeries: create two BarSeries with different lengths or different series objects, use closePrice of series1 minus closePrice of series2, expect IllegalArgumentException (or IllegalStateException). Need to guess actual exception type. In TA4J library, BinaryOperation likely throws IllegalArgumentException if series differ. We'll state IllegalArgumentException.

Group: minus_indicatorWithNullValue: create custom Indicator that returns null for some index, then call minus, maybe later when getValue is called will cause NullPointerException. But the minus method itself may not throw; but we can test that calling getValue triggers NPE. However requirement is exception scenarios for minus method itself. So maybe only null argument and series mismatch.

Thus produce JSON with groups.

Need to follow schema: each case input list of parameter objects with name and value. For null, value "null". For different series, value "ClosePriceIndicator(series2)". Provide expected exception.
